# ===== Assessment of non-zero exits and warnings
- reconcile cleavage_agent_unsupported (both parts, BLOCKER): FALSE POSITIVE. The PRIDE record never describes the digest; the
  digest cue the checker found is "cells cultured in medium amino acids were washed and incubated with heavy-isotope labelled
  ... Lysine (Lys8) and ... Arginine (Arg10)" - SILAC pulse labelling, not a digestion (record_reconcile._DIGEST_CUE matches
  "incubated with"). Enzymes are from the paper's Supplemental Methods ("digested in LYSE with 1 ug of endoproteinase LysC and
  1 ug of trypsin at 37C overnight") and the deposited MaxQuant summary.txt (Enzyme Trypsin/P, all runs of both searches).
  The IP part declares Trypsin only, since its digest enzymes are not named (search rule Trypsin/P).
- reconcile labelled_annotated_as_label_free (hsp27-ip, BLOCKER): FALSE POSITIVE. PRIDE's project-level quantification "SILAC"
  describes the pulse-SILAC part. The HSP27-IP MaxQuant search (HSP27_only_IP_September_txt.7z summary.txt) has Multiplicity 1
  and no Labels column, and proteinGroups.txt carries LFQ intensity columns: these 12 runs are label-free (batch rule 12 split).
- convert-openms exit 1 (both parts): expected; comment[precursor mass tolerance] = not available because MaxQuant 1.6.1.13
  parameters.txt/summary.txt do not record it and no mqpar.xml was deposited (paper's "7 ppm / 10 ppm" sentence is contradicted
  by the deposited 20 ppm FTMS fragment tolerance). Probe: a scratch copy of the SILAC SDRF with the tolerance filled converts
  (round 2 re-run: exit 0, 18 conditions = 3 genotypes x 2 compartments x 3 time points; only warning "no TA= specified" for PP=Protein N-term
  Acetyl); {D}/convert_silac/probe_out.txt. Same outcome as campaign precedents PXD014368/PXD006676.
- validate-sdrf warning (hsp27-ip): "fetal stage" is HsapDv:0000037 (verified in OLS), not EFO; Cellosaurus CVCL_0063 gives
  AG "Fetus". Same value as campaign precedent PXD023136 (HEK293T). Warning-level only.
